core: Use case: stylized-concept. Production game sprite atlas for MONIGONES, a MODERN Spanish football club city-building game. One transparent PNG sheet, landscape 1536x1024, EXACTLY 5 equal columns and 3 equal rows, 15 separate building sprites. All sprites fully isolated with true transparent gutters, no text, numbers or UI. Row 1: football club headquarters, progression levels 1 to 5 left to right: small contemporary brick administration office, expanded two-storey HQ, modern glass wing, national club complex, spectacular modern football federation-style headquarters. Row 2: football stadium five stages, small neighborhood stadium with OPEN visible green pitch, then increasingly substantial stands and bowl, level5 contemporary arena with sweeping white roof OPEN center pitch. Row3 sports research center five stages, compact modern laboratory to advanced glass-and-aluminum sports medicine campus. Detailed high-end city-building game CGI illustration, orthographic isometric aerial view approximately 45 degrees down, front and right facades visible, consistent realistic Mediterranean daylight from upper left, soft shadows lower right, believable human scale, detailed glass reflections, flat roofs, roof machinery, concrete terraces and planted entrances. Use each cell fully while retaining clean transparent gutters. Each subsequent level has visibly more floors, wings and equipment. Buildings occupy bottom two thirds of their cell, stadium largest. Modern red brick, warm white concrete, steel, cyan glass, subtle terracotta accents. NOT cartoon toy miniatures, NOT low poly, no thick outlines, no excessive gold, NO castles, towers, palaces, crowns, medieval roofs, monuments, flags or fantasy motifs. Original architecture, no logos. High definition architectural textures and nuanced volumetric shading. Canvas must be TRANSPARENT behind every individual building.
ground: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: HIGH RESOLUTION raster ground/background map for a playable modern Spanish football club city-building game. Portrait 1536x2304. Original detailed orthographic isometric/oblique aerial CGI environment, consistent high-end mobile city-building game rendering, realistic architectural materials, daylight upper left with soft shadows lower right. Fill the ENTIRE rectangular canvas edge-to-edge with a DENSE lively modern Mediterranean sports district, no outside void and no sky or horizon. The principal functional buildings will be layered over the image by the game: leave FIFTEEN discreet medium concrete/plaza building plots distributed in three columns and five staggered rows, connected to a credible urban street network with footpaths and approaches. Main stadium plot, a broad oval paved apron, at center x45% y36%, should be the biggest space; other building plots at approximate normalized anchors x20/45/72%, y16/30/52/68/85%. Do not draw major stadium or major functional buildings inside those plots. Surround and integrate the plots with abundant small detailed decorative modern apartment blocks, low retail buildings, terraced cafes, service buildings, training football pitches at right-middle, outdoor small courts, parking lots with painted bays, diagonal crossing streets, zebra crossings, sidewalks, planted traffic islands, trees of varied Mediterranean species, fence lines, landscaped park strips, fan murals without letters, food kiosks, buses, a few cars and benches, street lights, a small civic square at bottom. Surrounding decorative buildings must be scaled smaller than the planned functional building footprints. Modern sports urban campus not an empty green village or a diagram. Roads should form coherent asymmetrical connected streets and curved perimeter, no repetitive parallel paths across each row. Use varied realistic mottled asphalt, pale aggregate concrete, terracotta pedestrian pavers, trimmed natural textured grass confined to gardens, layered shrubbery. Detailed ambient occlusion, facade balconies and glass, planted verges, rich density and depth, plausible proportions. Clean readable full rectangular game map background, no UI, no text, no labels, no castles, no medieval buildings, no crowns, no giant gold ornament. Avoid low-poly toys, flat vector SVG look, grid of identical trees, excessive empty lawns. Fine realistic game illustration with modern architectural detail.

props: Create an original premium realistic 2.5D city-builder GAME PROP ATLAS, transparent RGBA background, landscape 1536x1024. Match modern Mediterranean football campus architecture: warm brick, cream limestone, glass, saturated natural green, midday sun upper-left, shadows lower-right, consistent high oblique isometric-like view looking down at front and right sides. EXACTLY 6 separate clearly isolated clusters arranged in a clean 3 columns x 2 rows grid, generously separated with fully transparent gutters, no overlaps, each entirely inside its cell. Top row left: a small paved supporter plaza with TWO low brick food kiosks, cream umbrellas, benches, fan banner poles, shrubs. Top row middle: a compact rectangular parking row with 8 modern cars in neat marked parking bays on textured gray asphalt, a few palms, no enclosing wall. Top row right: a modern football team coach bus and small equipment van beside a paved pedestrian strip and two planters. Bottom row left: a landscaped pocket garden with mature trees, low benches, flower beds, pedestrian paving and subtle lamps. Bottom row middle: stadium entrance turnstiles with red-blue vertical sport flags, canopy, realistic metal barriers. Bottom row right: two modern small outdoor sports courts surrounded by low mesh fencing and shrubs. No letters, no text, no brands, no medieval features, no giant platforms. Fine high-resolution architectural CG details, physically plausible materials, perspective and illumination coherent across all six clusters. No interface, no sky, NO colored background. Make each cluster substantially smaller than a stadium, suitable as decorative urban infrastructure.
